mono.purpose: The sitting specimen and the install lines.

motion.name: caret
motion.purpose: The specimen caret. Off when the reader prefers reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--gold, #e6a23c); color: var(--ink, #0b0b0a); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6a23c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action beside the gold button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: var(--cream, #f4f0e6); border: 1px solid var(--line-2, #3a3428); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #e6a23c; color: #e6a23c; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6a23c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Site nav
components.description: Brand, the same links, and search.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; padding: 1.15rem 0 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2824; color: #b9b3a6; font-family: Source Sans 3, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { color: #f4f0e6; font-family: Source Serif 4, serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #e6a23c; }

components.name: Search field
components.css: .ds-search { width: 11rem; background: #141310; border: 1px solid #2a2824; border-radius: 4px; color: #f4f0e6; font: 0.92rem/1.3 Source Sans 3, sans-serif; padding: 0.32rem 0.6rem; } .ds-search:focus { outline: 2px solid #e6a23c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Docs card
components.description: A reading card on the docs index.
components.html: First writeInstall, write one claim, search it back.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; border: 1px solid #2a2824; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.3rem 1.25rem; background: #141310; color: #b9b3a6; text-decoration: none; } .ds-card strong { color: #f4f0e6; font-family: Source Serif 4, serif; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #9a6410; }

narrative.northStar: A field journal on a dark desk
narrative.overview: The page is a night desk: near-black ink, warm cream type, one gold rule. Serif headlines carry the claim. Sans carries the reading. Mono carries the specimen and the install lines.
keyCharacteristics: Ink ground, cream text, gold used as a rule, a kicker, and the primary action.
Source Serif 4 for headings, Source Sans 3 for reading, IBM Plex Mono for commands.
One nav and one stylesheet across the landing page, the docs, and the handbook.
Flat panels. Depth is a 1px line, not a shadow.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the action and the figure. It does not recolor body paragraphs.

rules.name: The Recorded Faces Rule
rules.body: Do not swap these faces for another display family. The serif, the sans, and the mono in site.css are the system.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Do not add drop shadows. A border is the edge of a plate.

dos: Do keep ink, cream, and gold as defined in site.css.
Do keep Source Serif 4, Source Sans 3, and IBM Plex Mono.
Do use the same nav and site.css on the landing page, the docs, and the handbook.
donts: Don't replace the palette with a different gold or a paper-white page.
Don't replace the serif, the sans, or the mono with another display family.
Don't publish a handbook page whose nav or stylesheet bypasses the org templates.
